intake.description: Heavy rain caused surface water to enter the basement store room of the insured property, soaking and ruining stored items including a sofa set, mattresses, books, and winter clothes. The estimated value of the damaged items is Rs 1,10,000.

citations.quote: We pay for damage to the home and contents caused by storm, high winds or flood, subject to PROP-EXC-4.3.
Water entering the home from overflowing rivers, lakes or drains, or from the build-up of surface rainwater.

coverage.reasoning: The claim involves damage to stored contents in the basement caused by surface water from heavy rain, which qualifies as a flood under the policy definition PROP-DEF-1.4. Clause PROP-COV-2.3 provides coverage for damage to contents caused by a flood. Therefore, the loss is covered under the storm and flood provision.
